messages:
Seema: follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — need a concise "next steps" for API streaming SLA, Console canary UX, and Optimize suggestions. PMs want one-sentence asks for squads. :calendar:

Dmitri: TL;DR: SLA beta in 3w, GA ~7w; canary UI dogfood 2w, public beta 5w; Optimize staging now, GA EOY-quarter. will attach dates + minimal checklist.

Jess: can you specify the SLA metric? per-token p95 or end-to-end p95?

Dmitri: per-token issuance p95 at model host for sequences <=2k. we'll publish a spec.

Hao: Console canary API will follow UI—what's the default canary_percent and auto-rollback behavior?

Marco: default canary_percent 10, canary_window_min 30, auto_rollback_on_errors true. small snippet we'll expose:
```json
{"canary_percent":10,"canary_window_min":30,"auto_rollback_on_errors":true}
```

Jess: for Optimize, teams want a simple way to preview quality impact before apply.

Dmitri: done—Optimize will surface expected token savings + quality-risk score and a preview run of golden prompts. auto-apply off by default.

Seema: please drop dates + checklist in roadmap doc. @deploy-bot can you schedule dogfood reminders for canary and SLA beta windows?

deploy-bot: Reminders scheduled: console-canary-dogfood 2026-04-18, streaming-sla-beta 2026-04-25. :white_check_mark:

Hao: I'll coordinate SRE for load tests. Jess/PMs, DM me your routes to include.

Seema: thanks all — closing this thread; DM me to join betas.
